200.description: What the reconcile did, and the onboarding as it now stands.

outcome.description: What an operator reconcile did: `applied` moved the onboarding with the verdict the provider holds, `still_pending` found the provider undecided and changed nothing, `superseded` found the onboarding no longer parked on that attempt and changed nothing.

allOf.description: What an operator reconcile did: `applied` moved the onboarding with the verdict the provider holds, `still_pending` found the provider undecided and changed nothing, `superseded` found the onboarding no longer parked on that attempt and changed nothing.
allOf.title: PendingConnectorReconcileOutcome

onboarding.description: The onboarding record after the reconcile, as the admin list reports it.

workflowVersion.description: The workflow revision the onboarding is pinned to.

status.description: Where an onboarding stands. `awaiting_user` and `awaiting_manual_review` are live; `approved`, `rejected` and `invalid` are terminal.

allOf.description: Where an onboarding stands. `awaiting_user` and `awaiting_manual_review` are live; `approved`, `rejected` and `invalid` are terminal.
allOf.title: WorkflowStatus

currentStep.description: The step awaiting data; null once the onboarding is terminal.

expiresAt.description: Reserved. Onboardings do not expire yet, so this is always null.

completedAt.description: When the onboarding reached a terminal status; null while it is still running.

rejectionReason.description: Why a connector refused, when a rejection a connector drove ended the onboarding.

allOf.description: Why a connector refused the step's data: the caller exhausted its attempts, the challenge expired or was never issued, or the provider rejected outright.
allOf.title: ConnectorRejectionReason

scores.description: The current value of every score the workflow declares, keyed by score name.

agreementStatus.description: Aggregated over every agreement family the onboarding holds, as the `onboarding_agreement_statuses` view derives it; `not_accepted` when it holds none.

allOf.description: Where an onboarding stands on an agreement family, or on every family it holds: `not_accepted` while there is no accepted version, `outdated` when there is one but a newer version has been published, `current` otherwise. Derived, never stored.
allOf.title: OnboardingAgreementStatus

pendingConnector.description: The connector the onboarding is parked on awaiting a callback; null when it is not waiting for one, and for onboardings parked before this was recorded.

connectorId.description: The id of the connector the onboarding is waiting on.

connectorName.description: The name the workflow step gives that connector declaration.

connectorOrder.description: The order of the connector slot on the step the connector was parked in.

parkedAt.description: When the onboarding was first parked on this connector; null for a row parked before the engine recorded it.

400.description: `INVALID_STEP_DATA`: The submitted data violates the current step; `errors` maps each refused field to its reasons (`UNKNOWN`, `REQUIRED`, `INVALID`, `CALLBACK_ONLY`, or a connector's own), and the onboarding stays where it was.

allOf.description: The engine's own error envelope. `code` is the stable identifier a client branches on; `message` repeats it. A code that adds detail properties is described on the operation that returns it.
allOf.title: ApiError

401.description: No bearer token, or the token fails signature, issuer, audience or expiry verification.

schema.description: NestJS's default error envelope, returned where the framework answers instead of the engine: request validation (`400`, `message` lists each violated rule), the admin bearer guard (`401`, `403`, `503`), and a `500` on the submit and provider-callback routes where a connector adapter fails with a plain error rather than a coded refusal.
schema.title: NestHttpError

403.description: The token verifies but its `roles` claim holds none of `ADMIN_REQUIRED_ROLES`; signing in again cannot fix this.

404.description:
`ONBOARDING_NOT_FOUND`: No onboarding has this id.

`WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND`: No published workflow has this id, or no revision of it carries the pinned version.

409.description:
`ONBOARDING_NOT_AWAITING_CONNECTOR`: The onboarding is not parked on a connector, so there is no provider attempt to read back.

`PENDING_CONNECTOR_RECONCILE_UNSUPPORTED`: The parked connector cannot be reconciled: its adapter offers no read-back from the provider (`reason: adapter`), or the park records no provider attempt to read (`reason: reference_missing`). Wait for the callback, or review the onboarding by hand.

`ONBOARDING_COMPLETED`: The onboarding is already approved or completed and accepts no further moves.

`UNKNOWN_WORKFLOW_EVALUATION`: The workflow produced no outcome the engine can apply; the onboarding is left unchanged.

410.description: `WORKFLOW_RETIRED`: The pinned revision is retired and can no longer be read or run.

500.description:
A connector failed in a way its adapter raises as a plain error rather than one of the codes below: an `http_request` call that could not be sent or answered with an unexpected status, a Sumsub level or credential that does not resolve, or a Veriff credential or payload that does not resolve. The framework answers with its own envelope, so there is no `code` to branch on; the connector, the step and the reason are in the audit trail.

`CLIENT_WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_FAILED`: The client webhook for this move could not be delivered; the outbox entry was returned to pending for the worker to retry.

`TWILIO_VERIFY_UNAVAILABLE`: Twilio Verify could not be reached, or answered with an error the adapter does not map to an outcome.

`SENDGRID_EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE`: SendGrid could not be reached, or answered with an error the adapter does not map to an outcome.

`SUMSUB_UNAVAILABLE`: Sumsub could not be reached, or answered with an error the adapter does not map to an outcome.

`VERIFF_UNAVAILABLE`: Veriff could not be reached, or answered with an error the adapter does not map to an outcome.

503.description:
`AGREEMENT_NOT_PUBLISHED`: The workflow declares an agreement family nobody has published a version of; `key` names it. An operator publishes one and the same request then succeeds.

`CONNECTOR_NOT_CONFIGURED`: A connector the step calls has a required setting with no value; carries `connectorId` and `key`.

Entra's signing key set could not be reached, so the token was never judged. Retry.
